scope: RoboTwin/SAPIEN left-stick contact and signal vertical slice

kinematics.applicability: Artist-rig pivot and axes plus a reference-component angular envelope; not measured Xbox mechanics.

collision_geometry.method: Axisymmetric primitives fitted to metric-scaled visual vertex radial profiles; a 16-segment convex box ring represents the shell gate.
limitations: The visual meshes are not watertight and are not used as mass solids.
The hidden artist skirt intersects the shell surface and is excluded from collision.
The gate is a contact proxy for the visible opening and unobserved internal stop.

mass_properties.derivation: The artist stick signed-volume proxy is 1.66 percent of the artist body proxy; multiplying by the Microsoft battery-loaded whole mass gives 4.66 g, rounded to 5 g. Both meshes are open and material densities differ, so the value is an explicit simulation estimate with a broad sensitivity range.
mass_properties.applicability: Numerically explicit inertial estimate for the fixed-root vertical slice; not an identified hardware mass distribution.

passive_dynamics.damping_method: Near-critical damping estimate from the nominal stiffness and an 0.8e-6 kg m2 effective rotational inertia.

state_mapping.deadzone_reason: No measured hardware deadzone; expose raw normalized articulation coordinates.

required: URDF loads as one fixed-root articulation with two scalar active joints
neutral and signed endpoint state mapping
radial signal projection at diagonal overtravel
fixed-step stability across the declared mass and friction sensitivity ranges
visual link motion remains registered to the approved SAPIEN appearance asset
validation.hardware_replacement: Replace angle, torque, damping, friction and mass estimates after measuring the owner's controller.
